Type: two-drawer console table
Use: entry or behind-sofa display and storage; living room, hallway
Style: classic, coastal, traditional
Materials: painted wood, fretwork side panels, round knobs
Colors: white, pale blush knobs
Shape: long rectangular top, two drawers, geometric lattice cutout sides, open lower shelf, square straight legs, slim and medium visual weight
Feel: crisp, fresh, polished
Goes with: blue and white decor, rattan, light walls; coastal or classic rooms
